agent_contract.deterministic: stable JSON key ordering via serde_json; doctor/capabilities envelopes omit TTY and wall-clock fields; bench history honors SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH; disable color with NO_COLOR=1
agent_contract.stderr: empty in machine modes; human diagnostics otherwise
agent_contract.stdout: one data payload in machine/default-agent modes

exit_codes.meaning: usage error (missing required args, unknown flags, invalid --format, conflicting roots)

indexed_source.exact_text: Use literal:<term> for exact substring presence in indexed languages.
indexed_source.freshness: CLI: search is read-only (no auto-index/refresh) unless --auto-index; run asgrep index / reindex / watch to write; Pi and Code Mode refresh before search with a 30-second default correctness lease; LSP applies document open/change/save/close before the next request.
indexed_source.outside_contract: Use ripgrep only for logs and unindexed or unsupported files.
indexed_source.policy: Do not spawn rg on indexed source.

machine_schema.notes: ok:true only on successful operations; doctor uses ok:false when healthy:false; operational faults use exit_code 2

notes.default_search: Bare QUERY without a subcommand runs hybrid search; the word 'search' is not a required verb — use the `search`/`find`/`query` subcommand only when you want an explicit search command.
notes.safe_mutating: index refreshes incrementally with transactional writes. reindex forces a full transactional rewrite -- prefer `asgrep reindex --dry-run <ROOT> --json` before a full reindex. codemod dry-run always emits a JSON edit plan; apply requires `--yes` (alias `--force`) and commits one source transaction before a separate incremental index transaction. A source-apply failure rolls back source files; an index-refresh failure leaves the source edits applied and reports `asgrep index` as recovery.

root_specification.canonical: positional ROOT on the subcommand (or bare-search ROOT)
root_specification.precedence: conflicting --root and positional ROOT is a usage error; effective_root prefers --root when set
